statement: For the fixed 18-facet triangulated torus S defined verbatim in source.md and precisely interpreted in problem.md, the minimum number of 2-circuits in a facet-exact 2-circuit decomposition is c(S)=3. The cyclic words 105374, 216587, and 023648 form a minimum decomposition. Modulo cyclic rotation and reversal of individual circuits and permutation of circuits, there are exactly three labeled minimum decompositions; the automorphism group Aut(S) has order 108 and is transitive on them, so there is exactly one minimum-decomposition orbit after also quotienting by Aut(S).
contribution: This supplies a complete exact resolution of the frozen finite question. It gives an explicit three-circuit decomposition and a replayable exhaustive exclusion of one- and two-circuit decompositions via all orbits of the uniquely forced ordered cross-edge transition. It also certifies the optional minimum-decomposition count and automorphism quotient. The inspected primary source gives the displayed upper bound and leaves only the one-circuit exclusion to the reader; no equivalent two-circuit exclusion or exact census was found in the inspected source.
